info.about: Kenka Bancho: Badass Rumble, known in Japan as Kenka Banchō 3: National Conquest , is a PlayStation Portable beat 'em up video game released in 2008 in Japan and Asia, and in 2009 in the United States.
info.trivia: Atlus let fans vote on the North American title, which is how Kenka Bancho 3 became Badass Rumble.
info.why: It is the only Kenka Bancho game released in English, and Atlus has announced no plans to localize any of the later entries.
